scene: You step off the milk float onto the bustling Night Bakery Street.
picture: Side-scrolling street scene on a single ground line. On the far left sits an electric milk float. The player in teal bomber jacket stands left of center. Center shows a warm bakery window beneath an iron ladder fixed up high. On the right, a brass pastry robot kneads dough beneath an awning.
shown: a vintage electric milk float parked on the far left
a brass pastry robot kneading dough under an awning on the right
an iron ladder fixed up high above the center bakery window

variants.scene: Warm bread aromas greet you as you arrive while humming {tune}.
You arrive outside the brightly lit bakery beneath the purple twilight sky.
Neon signs glow softly along the street as fresh loaves bake inside.
